pages.text_en: Welcome aboard the Billionaires, maiden voyage special, tickets only $10,000. Daylight robbery! Come check my poor man's joy, only $1! Behold, the pinnacle of luxury, the brilliance! Behold my mud fortress, it floats, theoretically!

sentences.text_en: Welcome aboard the Billionaires,
maiden voyage special, tickets only $10,000.
Daylight robbery!
Come check my poor man's joy, only $1!
Behold, the pinnacle of luxury, the brilliance!
Behold my mud fortress, it floats, theoretically!

pages.text_en: We have a heated pool, five-star chefs, and even a redstone cinema. Your Kobe steaks, sir! We've got a bucket pool, and a fully automatic venting machine! Dang it, it just ate my $1!

pages.text_en: Wow, a giant squid, it's after my mud block! Phew, back off! I'm not tasty, it's all shell! Mikey, did your junk boat come with zero security?

pages.text_en: Activate laser defense system! Dinner is served, secret teppin' calamari rings for everyone! Phew, my shell almost got crushed!

pages.text_en: Uh-oh, the wheel seems hard-locked! My boat, now it's literally a 50% off-special! Force feels up! Nothing touches the brilliance! Money bag, huh? Show off!

pages.text_en: Our handover, all your treasure! All I got is charred wood and soaked mud, want some? JJ, help! They're about to feed me to the fish! No, they've seized that pile, uh, that boat!
